publication.title: Atlantic water temperature and climate in the Barents Sea,2000–2009

findings: The introduction describes a northward Spitsbergen Current that continues as the West Spitsbergen Current at the shelf break and Fram Strait.
Figure1 uses separate labels for the Spitsbergen Current and West Spitsbergen Current. This is contextual branch/segment nomenclature, not proof that the full names and full extents are aliases.
Figure1 is attributed to Rudels1994 and Ozhigin2000; it is not a new observed current-axis dataset in this2012 article.
The study concerns Kola Section hydrographic/climate time series; section endpoints are not endpoints of either named current.
